notes.title: Update 1.1 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28118973/8f89b50e8d92e4c0c52718ffb4eba782582fe987.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone! :D

[b]A Hole New World version 1.1[/b] has just been released! 

This version includes some bugfixes and improvements in controller support, as well as complete translations for Russian and Polish. Big thanks to [i]Dmitry Aleksov[/i] from EmuGamer for his Russian translation and to [i]Grzegorz 'Skay' Fedkiewicz[/i] for his Polish translation! :D

[b]Changelog for version 1.1:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added cyrillic pixel font
    [*]Added Russian language localization
    [*]Added Polish special characters to latin pixel font
    [*]Added Polish language localization
    [*]Updated controller plugin version
    [*]Fix: Potion Master no longer can receive a "double damage combo" (it normally ocurred against Baduk)
    [*]Fix: Cursor is now automatically hidden when over the game window
    [*]Fix: Missing Backers (the ones who answered after the release of the game) Added into credits 
[/list]

Right now you can play A Hole New World in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Polish and Russian! ^^ 
Is it still not in your language? If you would like to translate it, feel free to write us! ;)

Cheers!
